Initial release of travel-telecom-guide v1.0.0:

- Compare roaming, local SIM, eSIM, and portable WiFi options for travelers.
- Recommends the most cost-effective connectivity solution based on destination, trip length, and data/call needs.
- Provides eSIM purchase and activation guides for various countries and providers.
- Offers tips on saving data and recommends offline tools for different travel scenarios.
- No API keys or additional configuration required.
